method: classical rigid-body MD, reaction-field Coulomb (tinfoil), 20 ps Berendsen NVT then NVE sampling; playback only, not a live solve
atomOrder: molecule i: atom 3i = O, atom 3i+1 = H1, atom 3i+2 = H2

quantization.shape: one contiguous block: frame-major, then atom-major, then x,y,z
quantization.formula: x_angstrom = q * scale, q = stored int16 value, no bias, no offset

wrapping: per molecule: the oxygen is wrapped into [0, L) A with the true period L and the hydrogen offsets are kept, so no bond is split across the box; a hydrogen can sit up to 0.9572 A outside [0, L), use nearestImageDelta for animation
